text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

words.gloss_range: vocative particle functioning as an exclamatory cry of lament rather than ordinary address
words.prose: {{ar:يَٰ}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens as a performed cry, not as a normal call to a human addressee. Its vocative form summons the abstract lament that follows, so the ayah changes register before it states any proposition. Coming after the sudden closure of 36:29, the particle makes the next line feel like a parenthetical lament over a repeated human pattern.

topics.headline: vocative form becomes lament cry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by crying out over regret, not by addressing a person or starting a plain report.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar and attachment evidence both identify an exclamatory vocative unit, with the following abstract noun rather than a literal addressee.

topics.headline: narrative report shifts into lament
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a boundary shift from the destruction report of 36:29 into an evaluive lament over the wider pattern.
topics.reason: The particle starts the exclamatory unit after the prior scene, so the register change is locally anchored at the first word.

words.gloss_range: regret or lament, here an indefinite accusative verbal noun functioning as the content of the exclamatory cry
words.root_gloss_range: regret with root-family pressures of depletion, exhaustion, and exposure; those images color the local lament without replacing the regret sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition that directs the lament over the servants
the closing mockery verb that explains the opening lament

words.prose: {{ar:حَسْرَةً}} ({{tr:ḥasratan}}) is the substance of the opening cry: an indefinite accusative verbal noun made into a called abstraction. Its lack of possession keeps the regret unbounded until {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) directs it over the servants. The root family adds a narrowed image of depleted capacity and exposed loss, while the ayah's ending in {{ar:يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ}} ({{tr:yastahziʾūna}}) reveals the cause of that lament. The variant evidence sharpens the canonical choice: this reading is neither a plain predication, nor a possessed regret, nor a merely prolonged or paused lament, but an accusative cry directed by a separate preposition.

topics.headline: indefinite verbal noun becomes the cry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that regret is not merely named; it is grammatically staged as the thing cried out.
topics.reason: The local grammar licenses an indefinite accusative verbal noun in an exclamatory vocative construction.

topics.headline: unowned regret is directed over servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the regret is not assigned to one speaker or one event before the following prepositional phrase directs it.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite and the following prepositional phrase supplies the target of the lament.

topics.headline: regret carries depleted-capacity color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lament feels like exhausted loss and exposure, while the local gloss remains regret.
topics.reason: The broader root family supports exhaustion and stripping imagery, but the local verbal noun and construction select lament or regret as the active sense.

topics.headline: variant readings test the lament shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the canonical accusative and prepositional wording differs from variants that predicate, prolong, pause, or possess the regret.
topics.reason: Variant readings are useful comparison evidence, but the canonical local surface keeps an accusative indefinite noun followed by a separate prepositional target.

topics.headline: opening regret returns at final mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with the effect and ends with the cause: lament at the opening, mockery at the close.
topics.reason: The local word order places regret at the opening and the mockery predicate at the closure, and the cited regret-mockery comparison with 39:56 supports the same relation without governing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the target over or concerning whom the lament is directed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the servant class governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) turns the abstract cry into a directed lament. It governs {{ar:ٱلْعِبَادِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿibādi}}), so the servants are the ones over whom regret is expressed, not the grammatical owners of the regret. Its basic overness remains as pressure, but local grammar selects lament concerning them.

topics.headline: preposition fixes the lament target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the regret is aimed over the servants rather than possessed by them.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following genitive noun and attaches to the lament noun as its target phrase.

topics.headline: overness colors the directed relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a felt pressure of regret laid over the servants, while the grammar keeps the phrase as lament concerning them.
topics.reason: The broader prepositional range allows over and concerning, but the local lament construction chooses the target relation and permits burden imagery only as color.

words.gloss_range: the servants as a definite plural class, governed by the lament phrase and later resumed by plural pronouns
words.root_gloss_range: service, servanthood, worship, subjection, and related root images; local sense is the human servant class, with service-obligation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعِبَادِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿibādi}}) gives the lament a definite plural target. The noun widens the recently destroyed group into a recognizable servant class, then later pronouns make that same class recipients of messenger-arrival and agents of mockery. The service root sharpens the irony: those named by a relation of service are the ones whose habitual response fails that relation. Within the surah, that label answers the earlier call to follow in 36:20-21 and anticipates the worship/service thread at 36:61.

topics.headline: definite plural widens the target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lament is over a recognizable servant class, not only one named town.
topics.reason: The definite plural noun is governed by the lament phrase and can include the prior story as one instance inside a broader category.

topics.headline: same class becomes recipients and mockers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same servants from object of lament to recipients of arrival to agents of ridicule.
topics.reason: The object suffix on the arrival verb and the plural subjects in the final verbs are linked back to the servant class.

topics.headline: servanthood sharpens failed response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that those named as servants respond to messengers with ridicule rather than receptive service.
topics.reason: The broader root field supports service and worship pressure, but the local noun remains the plural servant class rather than an activated worship verb.

topics.headline: servant label joins the surah response thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the servant label answer earlier calls to follow in the surah, especially 36:20-21 and 36:61.
topics.reason: Same-surah evidence ties service and following language to the local servant label without replacing its immediate grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the restrictive mā...illā construction over messenger-arrival

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the exception particle that completes the restriction

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the proof beat by negating the messenger-arrival clause. Because its scope is completed by {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), the wording does not merely say that a messenger fails to come; it sets up a restriction in which no arrival outcome remains except habitual mockery.

topics.headline: negative particle scopes over arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is negative assertion, not question or relative wording.
topics.reason: The particle negates the following imperfect verb and begins the negated messenger-arrival clause.

topics.headline: negation prepares exclusive restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar excludes alternative responses and drives toward mockery as the only remainder.
topics.reason: The local construction is the negative-plus-exception pattern; the exception clause supplies the asserted remainder.

words.gloss_range: comes or reaches them; here recurring messenger-arrival with the servants as attached recipients
words.root_gloss_range: coming, reaching, bringing, and occurring; local grammar selects directed arrival to the servants

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the singular indefinite messenger universalized under negation
the negative particle reinforced by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيهِم}} ({{tr:yaʾtīhim}}) makes the proof clause an event-pattern: a messenger reaches them again and again. The attached object pronoun keeps the servants inside the verb as recipients, so the later mockery is response after contact, not ignorance at a distance. The same arrival formula is echoed with signs in 36:46, where another rejection pattern appears.

topics.headline: imperfect makes arrival recurring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lament is supported by a recurring pattern, not by one completed episode.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb remains indicative under negation and is placed inside the universal restriction frame.

topics.headline: recipient suffix makes rejection contact-based
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the servants reject after the messenger reaches them, not before contact is made.
topics.reason: The object suffix refers to the servants and forms the direct recipient relation of the arrival verb.

topics.headline: coming and reaching converge locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices directed reaching as the active branch, while broader bringing or occurrence senses remain secondary.
topics.reason: The local subject is the messenger and the object is the servant group, so the broad root range narrows to arrival that reaches recipients.

topics.headline: arrival formula returns with signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 36:30 and 36:46 as paired arrival-plus-rejection formulas, one with a messenger and one with signs.
topics.reason: The cited same-surah parallel at 36:46 repeats the arrival construction inside a rejection formula, but it functions as echo rather than as a different local sense.

words.gloss_range: emphatic preposition after negation, governing the indefinite messenger and universalizing the claim

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negative particle reinforced by the preposition
the messenger noun universalized by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) strengthens the negation so the messenger slot means not even one messenger from the class. It governs the following noun in form while functioning emphatically after {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), turning a simple negative clause into an exceptionless pattern. Its tight bond with {{ar:رَّسُولٍ}} ({{tr:rasūlin}}) makes the universal force audible and grammatical at once.

topics.headline: emphatic min excludes every instance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim is not about some messengers but about every messenger instance under the negation.
topics.reason: The preposition follows negation, governs the indefinite noun, and is identified in the guardrail evidence as emphatic or expletive.

topics.headline: particle binds to the messenger variable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the universalizing force is fused to the messenger noun rather than left abstract.
topics.reason: The particle directly precedes and governs the messenger noun, making the two-word unit the universalized slot.

words.gloss_range: any messenger, singular and indefinite under emphatic negation, while still functioning as the arriving subject
words.root_gloss_range: sending, being sent, envoy, message-bearing, and release imagery; local sense is mission-bearing messenger

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic preposition governing the messenger noun
the later singular pronoun that routes mockery back to the messenger

words.prose: {{ar:رَّسُولٍ}} ({{tr:rasūlin}}) is genitive in surface because of {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}), yet it remains the subject who comes to the servants. Its singular indefiniteness under negation makes every messenger individually available to the rule, which later allows the singular pronoun in {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihī}}). The sent-root keeps message and messenger together, so the mockery targets an envoy as a mission-bearing channel. The single indefinite noun also condenses repeated messenger-mockery scenes such as 6:10, 13:32, 15:11, 21:41, and 40:83 into one universal variable.

topics.headline: genitive surface preserves subject role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun is grammatically universalized without losing its event role as the arriving subject.
topics.reason: The preposition governs case, while attachment evidence marks the noun as the subject of the arrival verb.

topics.headline: each messenger becomes targetable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universality is distributive: each messenger instance can become the later mocked target.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite under negation supports distributive force, and the later singular pronoun refers back to this noun.

topics.headline: sent one carries message pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mockery of the envoy also strikes the authorized message-channel he represents.
topics.reason: The root family supports sending, envoy, and message-bearing, but the local noun selects messenger rather than an abstract message noun.

topics.headline: messenger slot summarizes rejection scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one indefinite messenger noun condense repeated messenger-mockery passages such as 6:10, 13:32, 15:11, 21:41, and 40:83.
topics.reason: The cross-passage references support formulaic resonance, while local grammar still controls the singular indefinite messenger slot.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the negative restriction and introducing the only surviving outcome

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negative particle whose scope the exception closes

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the restriction opened by {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}). It pivots the clause from negated messenger-arrival into the one positive remainder: they were habitually mocking him. The particle therefore diagnoses the servants by excluding every response except the final mockery predicate.

topics.headline: exception completes the restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole final predicate is the sole exception to the negated arrival pattern.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the exception clause and scopes over the following auxiliary-plus-predicate unit.

topics.headline: negation turns into diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the turn from no arrival-outcome left open to one exposed behavior: mockery.
topics.reason: The exception particle supplies the structural hinge between the negated clause and the positive behavioral predicate.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural auxiliary establishing a habitual past state for the following mockery predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, and auxiliary time-state marking; local use is auxiliary habitual state
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) begins the sole surviving outcome after the exception. Its plural ending returns to the servants, and its perfect auxiliary force makes the following imperfect a settled habit rather than a single insult after one arrival. The wording makes mockery look like what they already were whenever a messenger came, and the same formula echoes across rejection passages such as 6:5, 6:10, 11:8, 15:11, 16:34, 26:6, and 40:83.

topics.headline: perfect auxiliary makes mockery habitual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mockery is framed as a settled habitual state, not a one-time reaction.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary governs an imperfect predicate and is explicitly marked as establishing habitual past action.

topics.headline: exception exposes an already-settled disposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal layering: each arrival meets a response already described as settled.
topics.reason: The arrival verb is imperfect in the universal frame, while the exception uses a perfect auxiliary with an imperfect predicate.

topics.headline: plural auxiliary returns to servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the servant class as the same plural subject responsible for the final behavior.
topics.reason: The plural agreement is linked to the servant group already named in the lament phrase.

topics.headline: auxiliary enters repeated rejection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final clause as a compact version of a recurring rejection formula across cited passages.
topics.reason: The supplied rows cite repeated occurrences of the auxiliary-plus-target-plus-mockery phrase, while local syntax still gives it the exception role here.

words.gloss_range: preposition with singular pronoun marking the target of mockery, referring back to the messenger and implicating the mission he carries

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the singular messenger antecedent of the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihī}}) supplies the target relation inside the mockery clause. The preposition completes the standard mockery construction, and the singular pronoun points back to {{ar:رَّسُولٍ}} ({{tr:rasūlin}}), making each universal messenger instance the object of ridicule. Claims that the message is also implicated are narrowed: the syntax points to the messenger, while the messenger's mission lets person and message remain closely joined.

topics.headline: preposition completes mockery valency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ridicule is directed at a marked target, not left as a bare internal attitude.
topics.reason: The mockery verb is profiled with this preposition, and attachment evidence marks the pronoun as its prepositional complement.

topics.headline: singular pronoun routes back to messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks each universal messenger from arrival to the object slot of mockery.
topics.reason: The guardrail evidence identifies the suffix as referring to the singular messenger in the exception pattern.

topics.headline: message is implicated through the messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mocking the messenger also reaches the message he carries, while the pronoun's direct antecedent remains the messenger.
topics.reason: Rows proposing person-message polyvalence survive as implication, but attachment evidence blocks replacing the local pronoun antecedent with an unexpressed message.

words.gloss_range: they mock or seek to ridicule; here active imperfect Form X as the habitual predicate after the auxiliary
words.root_gloss_range: jesting, ridicule, contemptuous trivializing, and Form X pursuit of mockery; local sense is deliberate directed ridicule

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the auxiliary that makes the mockery habitual
the opening lament answered by the final verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ}} ({{tr:yastahziʾūna}}) is the final disclosed behavior: active, plural, imperfect mockery governed by {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}). Form X makes the ridicule deliberate and pursued, while the prepositional object keeps it aimed at the messenger. As the closing word, it answers {{ar:حَسْرَةً}} ({{tr:ḥasratan}}): the ayah begins with lament and ends with the cultivated contempt that explains it. The same closing verb also belongs to a repeated rejection formula across passages such as 6:5, 6:10, 11:8, 16:34, 26:6, and 40:83, and 2:15 shows the same mockery form turned back on mockers.

topics.headline: imperfect predicate reports habitual ridicule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb reports repeated directed mockery, not a command or a momentary mood.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is governed by the auxiliary and takes its target through the preceding prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: Form X makes ridicule active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the servants are portrayed as actively pursuing ridicule rather than merely finding the messenger laughable.
topics.reason: The local form is Form X active imperfect, and the lexical evidence supports deliberate contemptuous ridicule.

topics.headline: plural ending sustains collective agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the servant class remain collectively responsible through the final verbal ending.
topics.reason: The plural subject is controlled by the auxiliary and linked back to the servant group.

topics.headline: final verb closes a rejection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing mockery verb as part of a repeated rejection formula, while it also supplies this ayah's final cause of lament.
topics.reason: The formulaic rows cite repeated passages, and the local closure links the final predicate back to the opening lament.

topics.headline: same form can return on mockers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a wider Quranic reversibility in which the same mockery form can be turned back on mockers in 2:15.
topics.reason: The cited 2:15 echo is a valid contrast for the same form, but it remains an inter-ayah resonance rather than the local subject of the verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَسْرَةً with the universal مَا ... مِن رَسُولٍ إِلَّا ... frame
baseline_models.mechanism: Regret over a missed thing is distributed across every messenger-arrival: each carried message opens an encounter, and the habitual response converts every encounter into another irrecoverable loss.

activation_trace.role: The branch's regret over what has passed supplies the core affect and makes each rejected encounter a missed opportunity.
Literal coming and arrival make the loss recur at the point when something reaches the servants.
The bearer and carried message specify what arrives and why the encounter could have changed its recipients.
Occurrence in time gives the exception clause a settled, repeated temporal profile rather than a single reaction.
Mockery is the recurrent response that converts arrival into loss.

changed_reading.before: A general cry of sorrow because people mock messengers.
changed_reading.after: A lament over an iterated economy of missed arrivals: every carried message reaches the servants, and their established mockery turns each visit into another lost opening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْعِبَادِ as the recipients who habitually mock a رَسُول
baseline_models.mechanism: The recipients are named through an obedience relation, while the messenger is a bearer of a claim upon that relation. Their habitual mockery therefore performs an inversion of the very servanthood by which they are designated.

activation_trace.role: Worship and obedient submission make servants a relational designation, not merely a synonym for people.
The messenger as carrier of a message supplies the claim to which service should respond.
Temporal occurrence stabilizes the inverted response as an established practice.
Ridicule supplies the anti-obedient act that contradicts the recipients' designation.

changed_reading.after: Those named as servants repeatedly enact anti-service: they answer the bearer of a claim upon their obedience by making him an object of ridicule.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ح س ر branch cluster behind حَسْرَةً within a habitual rejection frame
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside regret, the focus root can image removal of covering, lack of protection, and exhausted capacity. The repeated messenger-mockery cycle can therefore be heard as exposing the servants, leaving them undefended, and spending their receptive power.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering and removal of a screen let the lament double as disclosure of the servants' condition.
Being bare of protection supplies the exposed and undefended aspect of that condition.
Spent strength and failed sight supply an attritional endpoint for the repeated response.
The temporal branch lets repetition, rather than one act, drive the exposure and depletion.
Repeated ridicule is the behavior through which receptive capacity is spent.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cry also diagnoses what repetition has done: the servants stand disclosed, stripped of protection, and exhausted in the faculty that should receive an arriving message.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heedlessness develops into a reception enclosure: barriers occupy both directions and a covering overlies sight, yet the resulting traces remain recorded. Against that sequence, the uncovering branch of ح س ر turns the lament into retrospective exposure of a blockage that had hidden itself while operating.

activation_trace.role: Removal of a covering supplies the reversal by which the servants' concealed reception failure becomes visible.
Lapse outside alert awareness supplies the initial inattentive state that warning must penetrate.
Filling a breach and partitioning two sides turns inattention into a front-and-back enclosure.
A covering that overlies and conceals supplies the screen that the focus root's uncovering can reverse.
A remaining mark of what was supplies durable evidence that failed reception leaves inspectable consequences.

structural_cues: 36:6 names inherited non-alertness; 36:9 places barriers before and behind and overlays sight.
36:12 records what people sent ahead and the traces they left; 36:30 then universalizes the failed encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heedlessness, enclosure, covering, durable traces, and the focus root's uncovering image; I infer that the lament discloses the hidden receiver mechanism after its effects accumulate. Ordinary regret remains a live, less structural reading.

changed_reading.before: The lament responds to a visible act of ridicule.
changed_reading.after: The lament also unveils the receiver architecture beneath the act: arriving messages repeatedly meet enclosed and covered attention, while the absences produced by that blockage remain recorded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The town sequence expands one messenger-arrival into a relay: envoys come, two are reinforced by a third, and a local man moves deliberately from the far edge to repeat their call. His request to be heard becomes, after the rupture, a wish that his people knew. The focus compresses this failed chain from sending through hearing to knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups make the focus messenger distributive and prepare the relay pattern.
Concrete coming places the first relay node at the town.
Successive dispatches bind the sending of two, reinforcement by a third, and their identity as a serial mission.
Purposeful motion toward a sought end turns the distant man into an active local relay rather than a spectator.
The bearer-and-message branch identifies what the local witness asks his people to follow.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the uptake the relay seeks, not sound reception alone.
Disclosure to a knower marks the knowledge the town fails to receive after the witness can no longer address it directly.

structural_cues: 36:13-14 moves from arrival to two envoys, reinforcement by a third, and repeated mission-identification.
36:20-26 moves from the far edge toward the town, then from a demand for hearing to the separated witness's wish that the town knew.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial sending, purposeful local movement, hearing-as-compliance, and post-rupture knowledge; I infer a communication relay whose links are intercepted by rejection. The town scene may alternatively remain only an example of the focus generalization.

changed_reading.before: A messenger reaches a group and is mocked.
changed_reading.after: The singular messenger stands for a redundant social relay of official envoys and a local witness; the lament falls on a community that interrupts transmission at every link between arrival, hearing, and knowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence establishes asymmetric traffic: messengers repeatedly come to recipients, destroyed generations do not return to them, but all recipients are finally gathered and made present. The lament marks the squandered interval of voluntary reception before compulsory presence.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the first direction of movement: the messenger comes toward the servants.
Regret over what has passed values the finite interval in which that arrival could be received.
Falling into destruction closes the ordinary route back to later recipients.
Return to a former point supplies the explicitly negated reverse movement.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the final convergence of all recipients.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity supply the compelled endpoint opposite the earlier optional encounter.

structural_cues: 36:30 has repeated motion toward the servants.
36:31 negates return from destroyed generations, while 36:32 makes universal gathered presence the endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three directions: messenger-arrival, generational non-return, and final brought-presence; I infer a contrast between voluntary reception and compulsory attendance. A live alternative limits the lament to destruction rather than the lost interval before it.

changed_reading.before: The servants lose the content of repeated warnings.
changed_reading.after: They lose a unique kind of presence: messengers come while response is possible, the destroyed do not come back, and the mockers will next be made present without control over the encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus construction recurs almost slot for slot with a sign replacing a messenger and turning-away replacing mockery. This makes the rejected messenger one personalized instance of a wider incoming-sign channel, and mockery one social form of a general policy of presenting one's side and refusing orientation.

activation_trace.role: The bearer and carried message make the focus arrival personal and communicative.
Mockery supplies the person-directed rejection predicate in the first version of the frame.
The same literal arrival verb carries the focus mechanism into the later sign construction.
A manifest marker widens the arriving object from a human bearer to any legible indicator.
Occurrence in time repeats the same established-response profile found in the focus.
Turning one's side supplies the generalized orientation of refusal for which ridicule is one interpersonal realization.

structural_cues: 36:30 and 36:46 share the sequence مَا, present arrival, مِن plus an indefinite noun, إِلَّا, and كَانُوا.
The variable slots shift from messenger to sign and from mocking him to turning away from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight syntactic reprise and branch-compatible rejection predicates; I infer that messenger-rejection belongs to a general reception policy toward signs. The alternative keeps messengers and nonhuman signs as parallel but functionally distinct tests.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns hostility toward a class of persons.
changed_reading.after: The mocked messenger is the personal face of an entire sign channel that the servants habitually decline; ridicule is their social version of turning their side to whatever arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge about when the promise will occur converts rejection into a timing strategy. A single cry then takes them while they dispute, and after rising they pair fulfilled promise with truthful messengers. Habitual mockery is thus exposed as borrowed delay that ends in the mockers' own too-late testimony.

activation_trace.role: Repeated occurrence in time supplies the durable stance that exploits apparent delay.
Ridicule is the focus form taken by the stance while fulfillment appears deferrable.
A promise bounded by a time or place supplies the challenged deadline.
Truthful speech supplies the criterion the challengers claim to test.
Waiting for a time and granting delay supplies the interval they mistake for safety.
Contention between opponents supplies the activity interrupted by the single cry.
A spoken promise opening expectation is retrospectively identified as the event now reached.
Realization of promise in action converts the earlier truth challenge into acknowledgment.
The same bearers of a carried message become the now-certified speakers in the mockers' testimony.

structural_cues: 36:48 asks for the promise's time as a truth test; 36:49 interrupts ongoing contention with one cry.
36:52 answers the earlier challenge in the awakened speakers' own words by joining fulfilled promise and truthful messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenge, waiting, sudden interruption, fulfillment, and acknowledgment; I infer that mockery functions partly by spending apparent delay as argumentative credit. The challenge may alternatively dispute truth without consciously relying on postponement.

changed_reading.before: Mockery is a stable verbal attitude toward recurring messengers.
changed_reading.after: Mockery is also a temporal wager: repetition lets the servants treat non-immediate fulfillment as credit against the message, until one event collapses the interval and makes them certify the messengers themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah commands make servanthood a contested allegiance rather than an empty human label: the local witness asks why he should not worship his originator, while the later covenant opposes service to the rebellious enemy and service to God. Mockery of the messenger becomes a public symptom of service already redirected.

activation_trace.role: Worship and submissive obedience make the focus designation an active allegiance relation.
Ridicule makes allegiance visible in the response to its messenger.
The witness's worship supplies the positive service relation grounded in being originated.
The prohibited worship shows that service can be redirected rather than simply absent.
The rebellious adversarial figure supplies the rival pole toward which service is forbidden.
Explicit enmity identifies the rival service relation as hostile to the servants themselves.
The positive command to worship restores the service direction implied by the focus designation.

structural_cues: 36:22 grounds worship in being originated and return.
36:60-61 states a binary covenant: do not serve the rebellious enemy; serve God on the straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit rival objects of worship and the focus label servants; I infer that ridicule is an allegiance-revealing act within that contest. A live alternative treats the mockers' behavior as disobedience without implying conscious rival worship.

changed_reading.before: Servants is a compassionate collective noun for people who reject envoys.
changed_reading.after: Servants is an ironic jurisdictional name: their ridicule does not place them outside service but reveals that the service relation has been redirected toward a hostile pole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late correction denies poetry and identifies the communication as remembrance and recitation whose function is to warn the living. That correction makes focus mockery a genre error: a carried summons is handled as verbal performance available for entertainment or derision.

activation_trace.role: The bearer of carried speech supplies the communication whose genre and function are at issue.
Mockery supplies the reception mode that reduces consequential speech to an occasion for derision.
Verse and poet supply the explicitly rejected performance category.
Bringing something back to awareness supplies the corrective cognitive function of the message.
Reading and recitation supply the positive communicative category paired with remembrance.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the message's intended practical effect.
The living being identifies the still-responsive addressee for whom warning can operate.

structural_cues: 36:69 uses a negative-positive correction: not poetry, but remembrance and clear recitation.
36:70 immediately states the communication's warning function and its living addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rejected and affirmed communication categories plus the warning function; I infer that mockery performs a genre downgrade from summons to spectacle. The ridicule may alternatively target the bearer without a specific poetry-category mistake.

changed_reading.before: The servants reject the message by insulting its bearer.
changed_reading.after: They also misclassify the event of communication: a recited reminder meant to awaken living response is received as a performance that can be neutralized through ridicule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition against letting their speech roughen the addressee's soul separates the focus lament from an obligation to absorb the mockers' words as personal grief. Comprehensive knowledge of what they hide and disclose relocates the lament toward an evaluative exposure that can coexist with protecting the messenger from their speech.

activation_trace.role: Regret over loss supplies the focus lament whose affective location is being reconsidered.
The mockers' speech-act supplies the pressure that could otherwise be internalized as personal sorrow.
The soul's roughening through grief specifies the affect that their speech is forbidden to produce.
Full disclosure to the knower supplies an evaluative standpoint not dependent on the messenger internalizing their words.

structural_cues: 36:30 voices lament over servants and their ridicule without fixing its speaker in the noun phrase.
36:76 forbids grief from their speech and grounds that prohibition in knowledge of both concealment and disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lament, a later anti-grief imperative, and encompassing knowledge; I infer an affective redistribution from private injury toward objective disclosure. The rhetorical voice of 36:30 remains open and can still carry prophetic compassion.

changed_reading.before: The line is heard primarily as the messenger's personal cry over being mocked.
changed_reading.after: The lament can function as a surah-level verdict on the servants' loss while the messenger is explicitly shielded from letting their speech become soul-roughening grief.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-default cold-strike branch of ه ز ء and links it materially to the immediately preceding extinguished town. It remains anchored in يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ and in the adjacent packet sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a thermal analogy, not as the lexical replacement of ridicule.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ immediately after the people become خَامِدُونَ

activation_trace.role: Severe cold that strikes or kills supplies a chilling material shadow to the ordinary mockery act.
A flame becoming still while embers remain supplies the adjacent extinguished state that the cold-strike image echoes.
Spent force supplies the depleted human endpoint of repeated chilling rejection.

changed_reading.before: Mockery is only a verbal response after which destruction happens.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, each messenger meets a chilling strike, and the extinguished town immediately before the lament externalizes the cold, spent social field that such reception produces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it carries the incoming-flood image of ء ت ي into the messenger relation and then reads the earth-and-water signs as a reception analogy. It remains anchored in يَأْتِيهِم and the packet's life, outflow, and drowning branches. Downstream prose should mark it as a hydrological model of arrival, not identify a messenger literally with water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَأْتِيهِم مِن رَسُولٍ, activated through the incoming flood branch of ء ت ي

activation_trace.role: A flood arriving from another land supplies the external current image for a messenger coming from beyond the receiving group.
Dispatch and release supply the directed transmission that lets the current remain a model of sent arrival.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the receptive, life-bearing potential of an incoming current.
Wide splitting and outflow supply channels through which the life-bearing current becomes available.
Drowning in water supplies the current's opposite potential when relation to it is no longer controlled.

changed_reading.before: A messenger is an external speaker who is repeatedly mocked.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a messenger-arrival behaves like an externally supplied current: received through opened channels it can enliven a dead field, while refusal of relation does not abolish arrival's overwhelming face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material biography rather than a direct gloss of العباد: clear generative fluid becomes an overt disputant who forgets formation and argues from decayed matter. It remains validly anchored in the focus servants and their mockery, but downstream prose should qualify the sequence as an ontological inversion that sharpens ridicule, not equate every mocker with the single late disputant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْعِبَادِ who mock the messenger, reread through the late creature-to-disputant reversal

activation_trace.role: Obedient creaturely service supplies the expected relation that the late material biography reverses.
Ridicule supplies the focus act in which the creature's reversed relation becomes public.
Clear water ranging from drop to generative fluid supplies the disputant's dependent material beginning.
Contention between opponents supplies the startling endpoint: dependent material becomes an overt adversary.
Loss of remembrance supplies the break that hides the creature's own formation from its argument.
Decay and disintegration supply the material endpoint the disputant treats as proof against renewed creation.

changed_reading.before: Servants mock because they reject an external message.
changed_reading.after: The mockery can be carried as an ontological inversion: derivative matter forgets its own making, promotes itself into an adversary, and uses another material phase as an argument against the source on which it depends.

strongest_changes: The exact 36:30 and 36:46 syntax reprise generalizes messenger-mockery into a standing policy toward every arriving sign.
The movement sequence changes lament into grief over a finite voluntary encounter: messengers come, destroyed generations do not return, and all are finally made present.
The town sequence turns one arrival into an intercepted relay from serial envoys through a local witness, hearing, and knowledge.
The whole-surah worship commands sharpen ٱلْعِبَادِ into a contested service relation whose redirection is revealed by mockery.
The promise challenge, sudden interruption, and later acknowledgment expose ridicule as a temporal wager that ends in the mockers' own testimony.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made recurrent constructions and long reversals do more work than isolated themes: covering is answered by uncovering, messenger by sign, arrival by non-return and compelled presence, mockery by eventual certification, and servants by explicit rival service.
remaining_uncertainties: The rhetorical voice and affective location of يَٰحَسْرَةً remain open even after 36:76 separates lament from imposed personal grief.
The physical ح س ر branches may be live connotative diagnostics without all belonging in downstream lexical prose.
The cold-strike, incoming-current, and material-biography outliers are packet-anchored analogies whose explanatory gain must be weighed against their branch distance.
The town relay may instantiate the focus rule without defining every occurrence of it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Repeated arrival produces cumulative loss.** `ح س ر` B004 is grief over what is missed; `ء ت ي` B001 arrival; `ر س ل` B002 messenger; `ه ز ء` B001 derision. The indefinite messenger under repeated exception generalizes the town's episode into a recurring reception pattern. I infer that grief accumulates because each arriving opportunity is converted into mockery. The ayah reads as lament over a repeated causal cycle, not one destroyed settlement.
2. **Servanthood survives failed worship.** `ع ب د` B001 is owned status and B003 worshipful obedience. Those who mock messengers remain called *servants*. I infer that ontological dependence persists despite refused enactment. The lament therefore addresses a contradiction internal to the fixed ayah: those belonging to the sender ridicule the sending.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:69-70 identified the discourse as reminder and warning, making the recurrent mockery especially tragic: what arrives repeatedly is precisely what could reactivate life.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Repeated arrival accumulates into depleted regret.** **ح س ر B004** anchors grief over what was missed, while **ح س ر B003** adds exhaustion/depletion; **ء ت ي B001** supplies arrival, **ر س ل B005** succession in batches, and **ه ز ء B001** mockery. The indefinite **مِن رَّسُولٍ** plus habitual **كَانُوا۟ ... يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ** supplies repetition; 36:31–32 supplies the accumulated destroyed generations. The inferred arrow is *each mocked arrival spends another opportunity until only regret remains*. **حَسْرَةً** reads as the terminal depletion of a repeated communication cycle.
2. **Servants invert service into proud refusal.** **ع ب د B003** anchors worshipful obedience in **ٱلْعِبَادِ**, while **ع ب د B008** supplies prideful aversion as a latent counter-branch. The fixed construction names them by service yet predicates mockery; the man's obedient counterexample at 36:25–27 remains in the backward window. The packet supplies both responses; the abduction is *mockery is service-capacity twisted into offended aversion*. The lament falls on a role contradicted by its bearers' conduct.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:31 turns prior generations into evidence, and 36:33 supplies revival as another visible sign. Regret in 36:30 is therefore not only missed obedience but repeated failure to connect arriving messages with observable consequence and renewal.

baseline.text: Yazık şu kullara! Kendilerine gelen her elçiyle mutlaka alay ederler.

findings.text: Her elçiyle alay edilmesi, her gelişte yeni bir imkânı tüketerek pişmanlığı biriktiren tekrarlı bir döngüdür.
Kulların elçilerle alay etmesi, varlıksal bağlılıklarını davranışta gururlu bir hizmet reddine çevirdikleri iç çelişkiyi açar.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Hud's call to worship God supplies only a basic instance of the shared messenger charge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It defines Christ as a messenger among earlier messengers, without the focus's hostile reception.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud's denial of the messengers further broadens the recurring communal pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger stands on proof while his audience denies it and demands judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns hidden reward for good works, not the focus's rejection or regret.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abraham's question probes the inherited objects of his people's worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies creative power to the beings invoked besides God, exposing false service.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The arrival of certainty marks an irreversible end, only generally related to the lament's loss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: It limits angelic intercession rather than addressing messengers, mockery, or worship refusal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God calls the departing Israelites His servants, a distant positive service relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts rapid disbelief and distortion around the messenger, but not the focus's mockery pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Each person comes alone before God, reinforcing the focus's accountability for response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns God's unrestricted withholding and sending of mercy, not the focus's themes.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It strips a claimant of possessions and leaves him coming alone before God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names the recurrent rejection of messengers whose teaching conflicted with human desire.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows selective belief used to reject a confirming messenger and the truth he brings.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It summarizes Israel's repeated response to messengers: some were denied and some killed.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts hearers who attend the recitation yet remain shielded from understanding it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes grief over the messenger from the audience's actual rejection of God's signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's leading opponents dismiss his warning as foolishness and error.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Arrogant leaders challenge believers over the divine sending of Salih.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Leaders threaten Shu'ayb and believers with expulsion unless they return to the old religion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Leading disbelievers warn their people that following Shu'ayb will bring loss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh's chiefs recast Moses's sign as the threat of a skilled sorcerer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh treats belief in Moses as punishable conspiracy rather than a response to proof.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Persistent denial remains even after the requested signs are brought.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelievers answer the messenger's warning by calling him an obvious sorcerer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: They demand a replacement revelation rather than receive the recited one.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: They deny a message before grasping its interpretation or seeing its outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's chiefs reject him as merely human and demean his followers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The people turn repeated argument with Noah into a demand that he bring the threatened punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's people mock him, and he announces that their mockery will be returned.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: 'Hud's people demand that their gods harm him, refusing his call through hostile challenge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Salih's people recast a trusted hope as a source of doubt after he calls them from inherited worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shu'ayb's people say they do not understand him and threaten stoning and expulsion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The resurrection denial asks incredulously about renewed creation after becoming dust.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Deniers demand a different sign while the Prophet is identified as a warner.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The audience rejects the Merciful despite a messenger reciting revelation to them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Earlier peoples reject what their messengers brought and physically signal their refusal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Communities voice doubt about their messengers' call despite its appeal to forgiveness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelievers threaten to expel their messengers unless they return to the former religion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mockers address the recipient of revelation as a man possessed.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The inherited way of criminals is described as a settled resistance to the reminder.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They do not believe it and mock even extraordinary disclosure, locating the focus in an older pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: When asked about revelation, deniers dismiss it as tales of the ancients.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Private opponents describe the Prophet as following a bewitched man.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They condition belief on escalating material and spectacular demands rather than the message itself.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The demanded alternatives show refusal to believe without self-selected displays.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They turn belief into a challenge for destructive cosmic spectacle.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They reject the human messenger unless he satisfies impossible demands and ascends visibly.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The objection that a human messenger came blocks belief after guidance arrives.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Human beings are characterized as unusually prone to disputation despite varied examples.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh is shown every sign yet denies and refuses it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: He receives Moses's proof as an attempted act of sorcery and dispossession.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The chiefs frame Moses and Aaron as magicians threatening their inherited order.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wrongdoers privately reduce the messenger's address to human speech and alleged magic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They cycle through rival dismissals of revelation: dreams, fabrication, poetry, then a demand for signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: They mock the promised judgment by demanding when it will arrive.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It lists earlier peoples who denied their messengers, giving the focus historical breadth.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It continues the record of communities that denied messengers and were then seized.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The elite reject a messenger because he is human and accuse him of seeking superiority.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They neutralize his call by alleging madness and recommending delay.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The affluent leaders discredit a human messenger who calls them beyond their inherited life.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They portray obedience to a human messenger as certain loss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Each community's messenger is denied, making repeated rejection a structural historical pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It asks whether they have failed to consider the word, received something unprecedented, or not known their messenger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly asks whether ignorance of the messenger explains their refusal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They answer the messenger's call by alleging madness despite truth having come to them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Opponents object to the messenger's ordinary human life and demand an angelic companion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It establishes that every prophet faces enemies among the guilty.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh threatens Moses with imprisonment if he takes any god besides him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh treats belief in Moses as defiant conspiracy and threatens severe punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's people threaten to stone him if he continues his warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud answer Salih by calling him one of the bewitched.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Lot's people threaten him with expulsion for opposing their practice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Midian calls Shu'ayb one of the bewitched rather than answering his proof.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They call him a liar and demand a fragment of the sky as punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud attribute their ill omen to Salih and his followers instead of heeding the warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When Moses brings clear signs, Pharaoh's court calls them fabricated magic and denies precedent.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It places the present audience beside many earlier communities that denied messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: They demand signs at will, while the messenger's role remains that of clear warner.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The evil end comes because people denied and mocked God's signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Affluent opponents of warners explicitly say they disbelieve in the message sent with them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When clear verses are recited, opponents call them magic and call the messenger's teaching invented.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It consoles the messenger by recalling that earlier messengers were also denied.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that earlier communities denied their messengers despite clear proofs, scriptures, and illuminating books.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The town narrative begins with messengers sent to a community that will reject them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The community denies the first two messengers even after a third reinforces them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They deny revelation and reduce the messengers to mere human liars.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messengers define their duty as clear delivery, setting the standard their hearers reject.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The town answers the messengers with an omen accusation and threats of stoning and painful punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messengers reject the omen charge and identify the community's excess in refusing admonition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A man comes urgently from the city's edge and tells the people to follow the messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: He identifies the messengers as guides who ask no payment, countering distrust of their mission.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: He grounds his allegiance in worship of the Creator to whom all return.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: He rejects intermediaries whose intercession cannot help against divine harm.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: He names taking such false gods as manifest error, exposing the alternative to the messengers' call.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: He publicly confesses faith in the people's Lord despite their opposition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believer's entry into the Garden displays the vindication denied within the town.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: His wish that his people knew his forgiveness and honor intensifies the lament for them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The audience responds to a sign with mockery even as the Prophet wonders.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Whenever they see a sign, they take it in mockery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They refuse to abandon their gods for a messenger whom they call a mad poet.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelievers marvel that a warner arose among them and call him a lying sorcerer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They reject the messenger's call to one God as an astonishing innovation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: They dismiss monotheism as something unheard of in the inherited religion and therefore fabricated.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It begins the sequence of earlier peoples who denied before their punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Every nation plans to seize its messenger and disputes falsely to nullify truth.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh answers Moses's mission by labeling him a sorcerer and liar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: 'Ad and Thamud reject the warning brought by messengers from every direction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Deniers instruct one another not to listen to the recitation and to drown it out.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When truth comes through a messenger, they call it magic and deny it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: They object that the Qur'an was not sent to a socially prominent man, recasting revelation as status competition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They turn away from the messenger and call him taught by others and possessed.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When clear verses are recited, deniers call the manifest truth obvious magic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Prophet is defended against the labels of soothsayer and madman used to dismiss him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They wait for the messenger's death by calling him a poet struck by fate.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's people deny God's servant and call him mad before driving him away.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It recalls 'Ad's denial and the consequence of the warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud's denial of warnings continues the repeated communal pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Thamud reject following a single human from among them and call his claim error and madness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: They treat selection for the reminder as implausible status favoritism and call him a liar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Lot's people deny the warnings, adding another historical instance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh's people deny the warnings before the stated seizure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The condemned ask whether no warner came to them, opening the accountability dialogue.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Prophet is defended against the accusation of madness used to discredit his mission.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Deniers nearly strike the Prophet with their looks when they hear the reminder and call him mad.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Qur'an is defended against the charge that it is a poet's speech.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The companion is defended against the accusation of madness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When signs are recited, the sinner dismisses them as tales of the ancients.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir örtünün başka bir şeyin üzerinden kaldırılmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; kolun açılması, bulutun dağılması, suyun çekilmesi, evin süpürülmesi ve kişinin huyunun sınamayla ortaya çıkması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yalnızca çıplak kalma sonucunu değil, örten ya da gizleyen unsurun kaldırılması işlemini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel açığa çıkarma çekirdeğini korurken rüzgar, kıyı, süpürme ve sınama kullanımlarını yalnızca kendi kalıplaşmış bağlamlarına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerindeki örtü veya engel kaldırılarak altındaki şeyin açığa çıkarılmasıdır. Bulutun dağılması ve suyun kıyıdan çekilmesi bu çekirdeğin doğal süreçlerdeki gerçekleşmeleri; süpürme ile huyun sınanarak ortaya çıkarılması ise yerleşik özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Örten veya gizleyen unsur kaldırılır ve altında kalan şey görünür ya da erişilebilir olur.
Rüzgarın bulutları dağıtması veya suyun çekilerek kıyının altını açması, doğal süreçlere aktarılan açığa çıkarma biçimleridir.
Evin süpürülmesi ve bunun için kullanılan araç, yüzeyi kaplayan şeyleri kaldırma düşüncesine bağlı özel kullanımlardır.
Bir kişinin huyunun sınamayla ortaya çıkarılması, gizli niteliğin açığa çıkması üzerinden kurulan değerlendirme kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, bir örtüyü kaldırıp altındakini açığa çıkarmadır. Aynı toplu tanıklık, rüzgarın bulutları dağıtmasını, suyun kıyıdan çekilmesini, evi süpürmeyi ve bir kişinin huyunu sınamayla ortaya çıkarmayı bu anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bütün özel gerçekleşmelerini düzenleyen temel kaldırma ve görünür kılma işlemini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örten unsurun kaldırılmasını ve alttakinin açığa çıkmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun kıyıdan uzaklaşıp daha önce kapladığı yeri görünür kıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geri çekilme sonucunda örtülü yüzeyin açığa çıkmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Rüzgar, süpürme ve kişinin niteliğini sınama kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Evin yüzeyini kaplayan kir veya döküntünün süpürgeyle kaldırıldığı özel kullanımda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzeyi kaplayan şeylerin kaldırılması işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel açma, doğal çekilme ve sınamayla ortaya çıkarma kullanımlarını vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin gizli karakterinin deneme veya sınama sonucunda anlaşıldığı değerlendirme bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli bir niteliğin işlem sonunda açığa çıkmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Fiziksel örtü kaldırma ve doğal çekilme gerçekleşmelerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Suyun kıyıdan çekilmesi ve kişinin huyunun sınamayla ortaya çıkarılması bu dalda açıkça yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal, yüzün açılması ile yaprak ve tozun kaldırılmasını ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da örten bir unsurun kaldırılmasıyla altındakinin açığa çıkmasını merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri güçlü biçimde örtüşür; ancak doğal su çekilmesi ve sınamayla huyun açığa çıkması yalnızca odak dalın, yüz açma ile yaprak veya toz kaldırma ise karşı dalın belirtilmiş sınırındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süpürme, suyun çekilmesi ve kişinin huyunun sınanması gibi yerleşik özel kullanımları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı veya kötülüğün ortadan kalkıp gizli şeyin belirginleşmesini ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir örtünün kaldırılması ve daha önce gizli olan şeyin görünür hale gelmesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel açma çekirdeğinde yaklaşırlar; odak dalın özel bağlamları ile karşı dalın sıkıntının giderilmesine uzanan soyut kapsamı tam yer değiştirmeyi engeller.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örtüyü kaldırarak altındakini açığa çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi örterek görünmesini veya erişilmesini engeller.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal, bir şey ile onu görünmez kılan örtü arasındaki ilişkiyi düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal örtüyü kaldırma yönünde, karşı dal örtüyü yerleştirme veya koruma yönünde işler; aynı eksende ters sonuçlar doğururlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan üç ilişki, çekirdek yakınlığını ve örtme eksenindeki karşıtlığı en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كشف الشيء عن الشيء وحسر الذراع والرأس وحسر الريح السحاب وحسر البحر عن الساحل ونضوب الماء وكنس البيت بالمحسرة وكشف المخبر بالاختبار
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس إعياء الدابة ولا كلال البصر ولا حسرة الندم
branches.source_phrase_ar: حسرت عن الذراع أي كشفته (maqayis); الحسر كشطك الشيء عن الشيء (ayn;tahdhib); حسرت الريح السحاب حسرا (ayn;jamhara;tahdhib); حسر البحر عن الساحل إذا نضب (ayn;tahdhib); حسرت البيت إذا كنسته والمحسرة المكنسة (maqayis;jamhara;sihah;mufradat); كريم المحسر أي كريم المخبر (maqayis;sihah;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişiyi zırh, miğfer veya baş örtüsü gibi koruyucu ya da örtücü bir donanımın bulunmamasıyla tanımlar; giysileri açılmış kadın ve savaşta bu durumda bulunan piyadeler de aynı kişi merkezli sınır içinde verilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, herhangi bir nesnenin açılması değil, insanın koruyucu veya örtücü giyimden yoksun bulunmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi merkezli korunaksızlık çekirdeğini korur; kadın ve savaş piyadesi kullanımlarını kendi belirtilmiş yapıları dışında genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin zırh, miğfer, baş örtüsü veya benzeri koruyucu ve örtücü giyimden yoksun bulunmasıdır. Giysileri açılmış kadın ve savaşta zırhsız ya da başlıksız piyadeler bu durumun bağlama bağlı görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Kişinin bedeninde onu örten veya koruyan beklenen donanım bulunmaz.
Erkek için zırhın, miğferin ya da baş örtüsünün bulunmaması özellikle belirtilir.
Kadın için giysilerinin üzerinden çekilmiş ve bedeninin örtüsüz kalmış olması anlatılır.
Savaş bağlamında söz, zırhsız ya da koruyucu başlığı bulunmayan piyadeleri topluca adlandırabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak tanıklığı, kişiyi zırh, miğfer veya baş örtüsünün yokluğuyla niteler. Kadının giysilerinin açılması ve savaş piyadelerinin koruyucu donanımdan yoksunluğu aynı kişi merkezli alanın özel kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: koruyucu giysisi veya başlığı olmayan kişi
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin zırh, miğfer, baş örtüsü veya beden örtüsünden yoksun bulunması çekirdeğini bütünüyle karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi odağını ve koruyucu ya da örtücü giyimin bulunmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Savaşta zırhı veya koruyucu başlığı bulunmayan erkek ya da piyade için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Savaş kişisini ve koruyucu savaş donanımının yokluğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Baş örtüsü ve giysileri açılmış kadın kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başında miğfer veya gündelik baş örtüsü bulunmayan kişi bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Başın beklenen koruyucu ya da örtücü unsurdan yoksunluğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Beden zırhının yokluğunu ve kadının giysilerinin açılmasını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadının üzerindeki giysilerin geri çekilerek beden örtüsünün açıldığı özel bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kadının giysi örtüsünden yoksun kalmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Zırh, miğfer ve savaş piyadesi kapsamını vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: zırhsız ya da başı açık kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zırh, miğfer ve baş örtüsü gibi beklenen koruyucu donanımın yokluğunu özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel giysi çıplaklığının yanında örtüsüz mekan ve eyersiz hayvanı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir varlığın beklenen örtüden yoksun ve açıkta kalmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insan ve özellikle koruyucu giyimle sınırlıdır; karşı dal çıplaklığı insan dışı mekan ve hayvanlara da genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Savaş zırhı veya koruyucu başlığın bulunmaması belirleyici olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Az ve hafif giyinmiş kişi ile eyersiz atı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insanın giysisiz, az giyimli veya giysisinden açılmış halde bulunmasında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal koruyucu donanım yokluğunu öne çıkarır; karşı dal hafif giyinmeye ve eyersiz ata uzanan daha genel bir açıklık alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koruyucu başlık veya zırhın yokluğuyla kişiyi niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Demir savaş başlığının kendisini ve onun giyilmesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal savaşçının baş koruması ve savaş donanımı alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal donanımdan yoksun kişiyi, karşı dal ise somut demir başlığı ve onu giyme eylemini anlatır; çekirdekleri birbirinin yerine geçmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler genel çıplaklıkla, giysiden açılmayla ve somut savaş başlığıyla olan en öğretici sınırları gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرجل الحاسر الذي لا درع عليه ولا مغفر ولا بيضة والمرأة الحاسر التي حسرت عنها ثيابها والرجالة الحسر في الحرب

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hareket gücünün yorulup kesilmesini; bakışın erişebildiği son noktada tükenmesini; sürdürme isteğinin bıkkınlıkla sona ermesini ve eldeki imkanların tümüyle bitmesini ortak bir devam ettirememe çizgisinde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yalnız bedensel yorgunluk değildir; görme, sürdürme isteği ve eldeki imkan da tükenebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel tükenme çekirdeğini verir; gözün yorulması ve elde hiçbir şey kalmaması gibi kullanımları yalnızca belirtilen yapılar içinde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın hareketi, bakışı veya bir işi sürdürme gücünün tükenerek devam edemez hale gelmesidir; aynı çizgi eldeki imkanların bütünüyle bitmesine de uzanır. Bedensel bitkinlik çekirdektir, gözün yorulması, bıkıp bırakma ve hiçbir şeyi kalmama ise kapsamı belirlenmiş gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: İnsan ya da hayvan, uzun sürdürmenin ardından gücünü yitirir ve bitkin düşer.
Göz, uzağa veya uzun süre bakmanın sonunda yorulur ve bakışını sürdüremez.
Bir işi sürdürme isteği bıkkınlık veya yorgunluk yüzünden kesilebilir.
Kişinin elindeki varlık veya imkan tükenir ve geride hiçbir şey kalmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, insan ve hayvandaki bitkinliği temel alır; gözün bakmayı sürdüremeyecek kadar yorulmasını, bıkıp bırakmayı ve eldeki şeylerin tümüyle tükenmesini de aynı devam gücünün kesilmesi çevresinde verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedensel güç, görme gücü, sürdürme isteği ve eldeki imkanın bitmesiyle oluşan ortak devam edememe çekirdeğini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem güç kaybını hem de sürdürebilecek imkanın sona ermesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın yolculuk ya da başka bir çaba sonunda bedensel gücünü yitirdiği bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel gücün tükenmesini ve devam edememe sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Gözün yorulmasını, bıkmayı ve eldeki imkanın bitmesini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bakışın uzun süre veya en uzak noktaya yöneltilmesinden sonra görme çabasının sürdürülemediği bağlam içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Görme gücünün yorulmasını ve bakışın kesilmesini birlikte korur.
error_profile.loses: Bedensel bitkinlik, bıkkınlık ve eldeki imkanın tükenmesi kapsamlarını vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin sahip olduğu şeyleri tüketmesi sonucunda elinde hiçbir imkan kalmadığı bağlama özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Eldeki varlık veya imkanın bütünüyle sona ermesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bedensel ve görsel yorgunluk ile bıkıp bırakma kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yorulup ya da bıkıp sürdürmeyi bırakmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tükenmiş varlığın ya da kişinin artık sürdüremediği son durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi kullanım, sağım, otlatma veya verme yoluyla tüketen süreci öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kaçırılmış veya artık elde edilemeyen bir şey yüzünden duyulan yoğun pişmanlık, iç sıkıntısı ve yanıp yakınmayı açıkça aynı duygusal çekirdekte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel üzüntüden daha dardır; duygunun nedeni kaçmış veya yitirilmiş bir şeydir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın duygusal çekirdeği verir ve onu herhangi bir özel yapıdan alınmış ek anlama genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Kaçırılmış, yitirilmiş veya artık erişilemeyen bir şey yüzünden duyulan yoğun pişmanlık, iç sıkıntısı ve yanıp yakınmadır.

facets.statement: Kişi, elinden kaçmış veya yitirilmiş bir şey nedeniyle pişmanlık ve üzüntü duyar.
Duygu sıradan bir hoşnutsuzluk değil, yoğun iç sıkıntısı ve yanıp yakınma derecesine varan güçlü bir tepkidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kaybedilen veya kaçırılan şeyin ardından duyulan pişmanlığı ortak çekirdek olarak sunar; yoğun yanıp yakınma ve iç sıkıntısı bu duygunun şiddetini belirler.

concept_gloss.text: kaçırılmış olana duyulan derin pişmanlık ve üzüntü
concept_gloss.applicability: Duygunun kayıp nedenini, pişmanlık yönünü ve yoğun üzüntü derecesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kaçırılmış şey koşulunu, pişmanlığı ve yoğun duygusal acıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kaçırdığı veya yitirdiği bir imkan ya da şey yüzünden yoğun pişmanlık duyduğu cümlelerde doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Pişmanlığın yoğunluğunu ve geçmişteki bir kayba yönelmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yanıp yakınma ve iç sıkıntısının tüm duygusal görünümünü açıkça söylemez.
